items.title: File Einspruch against the 2025 income tax assessment
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch erhoben werden.
items.computation: The letter states it was 'zur Post gegeben am 27.02.2026' (Friday). Under the 2025 PostModG rule for authorities, a letter posted on/after 1 Jan 2025 is deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting, counting calendar days and not counting the posting day itself: 28 Feb (Sat, day1), 1 Mar (Sun, day2), 2 Mar (Mon, day3), 3 Mar (Tue, day4) -> deemed delivery = Tue 03.03.2026. This is a Finanzamt, so under §108(3) AO if the 4th day itself were a weekend/holiday it would move to the next working day, but 3 March 2026 is a Tuesday, so no shift is needed at this step. The one-month Einspruch period under §355 Abs.1 AO then runs from that delivery date (§187 Abs.1, §188 Abs.2 BGB): one month after 03.03.2026 falls on the same day-number one month later, i.e. 03.04.2026. However, 3 April 2026 is Good Friday (Karfreitag), a nationwide public holiday, so under §108 Abs.3 AO the period end moves to the next working day. 4 April (Sat) and 5 April (Sun, Easter Sunday) are not working days, and 6 April is Easter Monday (also a nationwide holiday), so the next working day is Tuesday 7 April 2026.
